highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.119.5 backports Apple 26.0 TFM support and fixes the WinUI .NET 9 projection DLL.

bullets.detail: The SkiaSharp WinUI package no longer throws a DLL-not-found error for .NET 9 consumers.

bullets.lead: Apple 26.0 library TFMs and unversioned app TFMs backported
bullets.detail: Library targets now use the versioned Apple 26.0 TFMs while app targets use the unversioned form, matching Apple's SDK conventions for Xcode 26.

contributor_summaries.drasticactions: Backported Apple 26.0 library and unversioned app TFM support from the v4 line
